## Phone bars: more room, everything centred
- **Taller tab bar:** the bar at the bottom has the same extra room above and below, the icons and labels stay in the middle, and the marker keeps the same gap to the edge on every side
- **Mini player as tall as the tab bar:** cover, title and buttons sit in the middle, the cover is a little bigger
- Applies to Standard and Liquid Glass on Android and in the browser at phone size. Green keeps its Spotify layout

The Liquid Glass pictures on the website show the new bars.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
